title: Prove jf0 pairing cost exactly 19 with fixed minors
body:
## Result

The exact raw pairing cost of DreamingOfClouds's eleven-line `jf0` example is **19**, attained with coordinate ranks **(6,6,7)**. This closes item 4 of the [independent-check request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18934590); PR2162 reported only `cost >= 16` and left the minimum unknown.

Three fixed principal minors are unit triangular for every admissible binary pairing, giving the simultaneous lower bounds 6,6,7. The identity plus both directions of `(2,8)`, `(3,4)`, `(9,10)` attains them. The proof covers every one of the `2^41` admissible completions without enumerating them or relying on a SAT claim.

## Evidence and source binding

New package: `research/jf0-pairing-optimum/`. Full source configuration and proof, fixed lower/upper certificates, exact elimination checker and a code-disjoint row-span-set oracle.

- Base main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4.
- Predecessor PR2162 `113a718265c62aec301c5695f4bfb9c421bef7ab`; copied `data/jf0.json` SHA256 `cd8a8c2436e0a025348af0b52ccb48a4f64535b0ff8df32cbe13da73673266b7`. Source bytes, Git blobs, license and notice retained.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes, including 12 behavioral groups normally and under `-O`, actual triangular-guard removal, malformed supports, rational-incidence/diagonal/domain defects, nonattaining matrix, source/receipt corruption and missing evidence.
- The independent oracle finds row spans of sizes 64,64,128. Equivalent coordinate/label/gauge presentations and a different asymmetric optimum pass. Both mathematical checkers pass in an isolated read-only relocated package without changing files.
- `make selected-record-check` and staged whitespace checks pass. Full selected cold replay and Lean are not claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/jf0-pairing-optimum
```

## Scope and credit

This equality concerns the raw sum of three binary block ranks; it does not price the predecessor's additional floor or any physical supplier. No new kappa, general T=3 theorem, higher-order jet conclusion, frontier change or independent human review.

The selector drew portable-replay/verifier-engineering; TASK records the explicit scope change to this live mathematical handoff. Final overlap refreshed at 22:03–22:05 UTC: 421 open PRs and 855 Discussion records, full pagination and no warnings; only the predecessor/request and this investigation matched the scoped terms. Text search is not novelty proof. Canonical coordination: [Discussion2170](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2170).

Credit to DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 for the instance, prior bound and request, and the PR1590/PR2111/PR446/PR595 decoder lineage. Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate mathematical proof and independent-checker specialists. Apache-2.0; copied source notice retained.
